summary: Convert a vector data cube into a raster data cube
description:
Converts a vector data cube into a raster data cube (also known as "rasterize"). The spatial dimensions `x` and `y` of the raster data cube, i.e. their extent, resolution, reference system and labels, are taken from `target`. All other dimensions of `target` are ignored.

The geometry dimension of `data` is replaced by the spatial dimensions `x` and `y`. All other dimensions of `data` remain unchanged, e.g. a dimension with properties of the geometries (see ``load_geojson()``) or the temporal and bands dimensions of the result of ``aggregate_spatial()``.

The values of a geometry are assigned to the pixels as follows:

- Polygons: all pixels for which the point at the pixel center intersects with the polygon (as defined in the Simple Features standard by the OGC).
- Lines: all pixels that are touched by the line.
- Points: the pixel that contains the point.

If multiple geometries are assigned to a pixel, the values of the last geometry in the geometry dimension are used. Pixels without a geometry are set to no-data.

The geometries are reprojected to the spatial reference system of `target` if they are in a different reference system.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: A raster data cube that defines the spatial dimensions `x` and `y` of the result. All other dimensions are ignored.

returns.description: A raster data cube with the spatial dimensions `x` and `y` of `target` and all dimensions of `data` except for the geometry dimension.
